offences.quote: Any usage of GenAI tools in assessments outside what is explicitly permitted will, subject to investigation, be considered a breach of academic integrity, and may lead to disciplinary proceedings in line with RCSI’s Academic Integrity policy.
Uploading personally identifying, institutional, copyrighted or research-related data onto public GenAI platforms may be considered a breach of RCSI’s data privacy protection policy.

detection.quote: It is not advisable to rely on AI detection tools to detect GenAI accurately or reliably.
Employing follow-up oral examinations where academic integrity breaches are suspected
using version histories to verify students' work
